source: Three user-uploaded community solution ZIPs (manifest manually transcribed from inspected inventory) cross-referenced with public subject-node-index and full public subjects Git tree
caveats: Filename matches do not prove official Piscine membership, quest order, or completeness.
Go source folders preserve learner's own quest labels; no official verification.
Some solution filenames are scratch work and may accidentally match a public subject name.
Audit and resource presence means a path exists, not that its contents or requirements have been semantically reviewed.
This manifest includes two manually recovered Go QUEST-01 extensionless/directory candidates, in addition to filename-derived candidates.
